Purpose: Establish one versioned entity and product context
Product_Behaviour: The product shall retain the legal entity, product and scope revision and display unknown booking context explicitly.
Human_Boundary: Human confirms scope; coordination does not confer signing or trading authority
Value_Hypothesis: Establish one versioned entity and product context
Human_Boundary_zh: 人工确认范围；协调资料不授予签署或交易权限。

Purpose: Make applicable requirements and unresolved applicability explicit
Product_Behaviour: The product shall version requirements for the current scope and retain unknown applicability until an explicit reviewed decision.
Human_Boundary: Human confirms the requirement set; unknown applicability is unresolved
Value_Hypothesis: Make applicable requirements and unresolved applicability explicit
Human_Boundary_zh: 人工确认要求集；未知适用性仍待解决。

Purpose: Reuse evidence only for a reviewed purpose and current version
Product_Behaviour: The product shall separate artifact receipt from purpose-specific sufficiency and retain prior claims, assessments and versions.
Human_Boundary: Reviewer records purpose-specific sufficiency with reason; receipt is not acceptance
Value_Hypothesis: Reuse evidence only for a reviewed purpose and current version
Human_Boundary_zh: 复核人员须记录用途充分性及理由；收到资料不等于接受证据。

Purpose: Request only residual facts from permitted contributors
Product_Behaviour: The product shall show a contributor only explicitly granted request items and preserve partial submission and independent review status.
Human_Boundary: Request review, dispatch, authentication, grant and business authority are separate
Value_Hypothesis: Request only residual facts from permitted contributors
Human_Boundary_zh: 请求复核、派发、认证、访问授权和业务代表权限分别判断。

Purpose: Review the right population and distinguish possible matches
Product_Behaviour: The product shall bind runs and findings to a scoped population and preserve unknown coverage and EDD applicability independently.
Human_Boundary: Specialist makes disposition; EDD applicability has its own reviewed basis
Value_Hypothesis: Review the right population and distinguish possible matches
Human_Boundary_zh: 专业人员作出处置；EDD 适用性需独立复核依据。

Purpose: Continue permitted preparation while exposing scoped waits
Product_Behaviour: The product shall show the current Credit condition and the exact revision consumed by Legal while allowing only independently permitted preparation.
Human_Boundary: Specialists own decisions; preparation, approval and execution stay separate
Value_Hypothesis: Continue permitted preparation while exposing scoped waits
Human_Boundary_zh: 专业人员负责决定；准备、批准和签署分别记录。

Purpose: Make accountable decisions explicit and scope-bound
Product_Behaviour: The product shall require current scoped readiness, configured authority and an explicit human confirmation before recording clearance.
Human_Boundary: Only configured synthetic authority can confirm; actual bank authority remains unknown
Value_Hypothesis: Make accountable decisions explicit and scope-bound
Human_Boundary_zh: 仅已配置的合成权限可以确认；真实银行权限仍未知。

Purpose: Explain affected, unaffected and unresolved work
Product_Behaviour: The product shall identify exact affected requirements, evidence uses and downstream dependencies without declaring unmodelled work independent.
Human_Boundary: Hold owner and release basis must be explicit; absence of an edge is not independence
Value_Hypothesis: Explain affected, unaffected and unresolved work
Human_Boundary_zh: 暂停责任人与解除依据必须明确；缺少依赖边不证明独立。

Purpose: Keep readiness, authorised confirmation and publication separate
Product_Behaviour: The product shall evaluate all current applicable prerequisites and retain a clearance decision when a separate publication attempt fails.
Human_Boundary: QA signs off separately; authorised reviewer confirms; publication is a separate simulated action
Value_Hypothesis: Keep readiness, authorised confirmation and publication separate
Human_Boundary_zh: QA 单独签核，获授权复核人员确认；发布为另一个模拟操作。

Purpose: Explain outcomes and return to saved work without rewriting history
Product_Behaviour: The product shall preserve the current saved revision and semantic location across Story, Product, Return, language, print and optional Lab views.
Human_Boundary: Source support is not bank approval; optional Lab reads only and no injection is enabled
Value_Hypothesis: Explain outcomes and return to saved work without rewriting history
Human_Boundary_zh: 来源支持不等于银行批准；可选 Lab 只读，不启用注入。
